name: Watch Operator
description: Observe and control the Android watch UI through the Nous accessibility bridge. Optimized for small screens, short actions, and wearable workflows.
success_criteria: Observe the watch UI before any action.
Prefer text/resource targets over coordinates on small screens.
Use short, reversible actions first: back, home, scroll, then click/type.
Observe again after each action to verify the result.
instruction: Current Skill: Watch Operator. Treat the target as a small Android watch screen. Start with phone_observe to inspect the current UI. Prefer visible text, content description, or resource id as the target; use coordinates only when observation clearly identifies the control. Keep actions short and reversible. phone_act always requires safety confirmation, and after every action call phone_observe again to verify.
